youtube.shortcuts_help:
Ctrl+Space — play/pause
Ctrl+Alt+← / Ctrl+Alt+→ — seek back/forward 10 seconds
Ctrl+Alt+N — next queued video
Ctrl+M — mute/unmute
Ctrl+H — show/hide controls (manual mode)
F11 — fullscreen
Esc — leave fullscreen or close panel
Media keys and system playback controls use the Linux media integration.
